hints.title: Phase Based States
hints.text: Decompose the sequence into distinct stages representing the first rise, descent, and second rise.

hints.title: Transition Safeguards
hints.text: Ensure that the descent phase only begins after an increasing prefix with at least two values.

hints.title: Global Optimum Collection
hints.text: The answer is the highest sum recorded at any index in the final stage.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Maintains phase state arrays to accumulate maximal subarray sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all possible tri-partition boundary indices requires O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Can be optimized to O(1) space by maintaining scalar variables for the previous index.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Define state transitions accurately ensuring minimum length requirements per segment.
